backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (TimeEntry, JournalEntry, DailyMediaEntry, Fichier, UserProfile) and persistent storage maps for a work-time tracking application on ICP. Includes access control initialization and role management using imported AccessControl and Storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the time duration display formatting feature (hours and minutes format like '7h30') to its implementation file `frontend/src/utils/timeFormatting.ts` with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/ANDROID_REGRESSION_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist for verifying Android Chrome stability, covering bottom nav taps, header buttons, rapid tapping, console error checks, and admin publish dialog behavior. Requires testing on a production-mode build before publishing.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the React app, setting viewport meta tags and mounting the app into a `#root` div via `src/main.tsx`.
frontend/PRODUCTION_BUILD_RUNBOOK.md: Runbook documenting the repeatable steps to build and verify a production (minified) frontend bundle before publishing, listing prerequisites and build steps.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication state, profile setup dialog, tab-based page routing (dashboard/calendar/journal/reports), a session-scoped WelcomeDialog, and mobile bottom navigation. Renders different layouts for authenticated vs. unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/components/DayTypeCheckboxG: Reusable React component rendering mutually exclusive checkbox-style buttons for selecting a day type (Travail/Congé/Astreinte) with visual active-state styling and check icons.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that detects Android Chrome removeChild DOMExceptions, logs diagnostics via `logDebug`, and renders a user-facing error screen with safe deferred reload and go-back actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a caffeine.ai attribution link with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky app header displaying the TimeTrack logo, version badge, optional username, a login/logout button using Internet Identity, and a publish-retry dialog for admin users.
Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile (hidden on md+) with four tabs: Dashboard, Calendar, Journal, and Reports, using debounced safe-tap navigation.
frontend/src/components/PublishRetryDial: Admin-only dialog that requires confirming an Android regression checklist before triggering a publish workflow restart via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeDialog.ts: Simple welcome modal shown to new users that briefly describes the app's features and provides a 'Get Started' button to dismiss it.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook that manage AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and identity persistence using the DFINITY auth-client library.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for all backend operations including time entries, journal entries, user profiles, media, and admin functions via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeTap.ts: Custom hook that wraps async event handlers with debouncing, a concurrency lock, and rAF deferral to prevent double-tap issues and DOMException crashes on Android Chrome.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes (colors, sidebar, charts), and adds mobile-safe utility classes for safe-area insets, touch handling, and overflow prevention.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Calendar.tsx: Monthly calendar page that displays, creates, edits, and deletes time entries per day, with a dialog form supporting work hours, astreinte, intervention slots, and day type selection.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Analytics dashboard page that aggregates the user's time entries by weekly, monthly, or yearly period and renders summary stat cards alongside bar and pie charts using Recharts.
frontend/src/pages/Journal.tsx: Journal page allowing users to create, edit, and delete journal entries with text notes, audio recording (with microphone permission handling), photo uploads, and day-type tagging.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Reports page that filters the user's time entries by weekly or monthly period, displays a sortable table with totals, and supports CSV export and PDF report generation.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Utility that exposes build metadata (mode and optional build timestamp) sourced from Vite environment variables.
frontend/src/utils/debugLogging.ts: Debug logging utility that emits console logs and maintains an in-memory circular buffer of UI interaction events, active only in development mode or when explicitly enabled via localStorage.
frontend/src/utils/timeFormatting.ts: Provides utility functions for formatting and computing time durations stored as bigint hours or hour/minute fields, outputting strings like '7h30'. Includes helpers for normal work hours, on-call hours, and intervention slot durations/ranges.
frontend/src/utils/weekOptions.ts: Provides utility functions for computing ISO week numbers, week start/end dates, and generating labeled week options for a given year and month. Includes a helper to get the current week option.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens (primary, sidebar, chart, etc.), extended border radius, box shadow, and accordion keyframe animations, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for 'Heures Tracker', recording existing features (time duration display in 'XhMM' format) and a pending new feature request for HH:MM time formatting.
